request: Analyze GSE74570 for PMID 27508874 (Loss of NAD Homeostasis Leads to Progressive and Reversible Degeneration of Skeletal Muscle.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk polyA RNA-seq, quadriceps muscle, mouse (C57BL/6), HTSeq gene counts (GEO data_processing)
final.primary_estimand: Transcriptome effect of skeletal-muscle Nampt genotype (knockout or overexpression) and of age on quadriceps gene expression. Exercise is used only as a phenotypic readout (treadmill tolerance tests, S2.1.p3, S2.2.p2, S2.4.p1), never as an intervention whose transcriptional effect is measured.
planned_contrasts: mNKO vs WT at 7 months (S2.2.p3; paper: 33% of detectable genes significant, Table S1)
mNTG vs WT at 24 months (S2.4.p1; paper: 18 genes, Table S2, FIG7 F)
WT 24m vs WT 4m and mNTG 24m vs mNTG 4m age effects (S2.4.p1; 87 overlapping genes, FIG7 G-H)
mNTG vs WT at 4 months (GEO supplementary DESeq table only)
final.exercise_arm: none: no RNA-seq sample is labelled exercised/trained vs sedentary; treatment_protocol_ch1 says mice were only 'occasionally subjected to glucose and exercise tolerance tests before sacrifice' (applies to all groups alike)
final.inclusion: 23 GSM samples: WT 7m (4), mNKO 7m (4), WT 4m (4), mNTG 4m (3), WT 24m (4), mNTG 24m (4)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 (GEO data_processing; RNA-seq statistics in Supplemental Information, not available here)

paper_threshold.source_locator: FIG7 (Padj); exact rule in Supplemental Information not available
paper_threshold.note: FIG7 legend marks significance by Padj; S2.4.p1 mentions 'relaxed selection criteria' without stating them

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Paper (S2.2.p3, S2.4.p1, S4.6.p1, FIG3, FIG7) sequenced quadriceps to study Nampt knockout, Nampt overexpression and aging. Treadmill exercise appears only as a functional endpoint (FIG1J, FIG2G, FIG4A, FIG5A-D, FIG7D). No sequenced group differs by exercise exposure.

checks: GEO source quadriceps muscle, Mus musculus, genotypes and ages match FIG3/FIG7 groups
RAW.tar holds 23 per-sample HTSeq gencode count files named by GSM

ownership.reasoning: Accession named in paper methods; sample groups match the paper's RNA-seq groups.

alignment.reasoning: Tar columns are GSM ids, matching the metadata index exactly. Genotype from title prefix, age from the age characteristic.

final.paper_input: HTSeq counts analysed with DESeq2 (GEO data_processing)

matrix.reasoning: GEO data_processing: HTSeq gene counts, DESeq2. The other supplementary files are DESeq2 result tables (baseMean/log2FoldChange/padj), not expression matrices.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast exists in GSE74570: the sequenced groups differ only by Nampt genotype (WT/KO/OE) and age (4/7/24 months). Exercise was a phenotypic test applied to all mice (treatment_protocol_ch1), not a sequenced factor, so the requested estimand (effect of exercise on gene expression) is not identifiable. Running genotype or age contrasts and calling them exercise effects would misrepresent the study.

candidates.value: grp OE_m24 vs WT_m24 (mNTG mice have better exercise capacity, S2.4.p1)
candidates.reason_rejected: genotype contrast; exercise capacity is a phenotype of the genotype, not an exercise intervention

candidates.value: grp KO_m7 vs WT_m7 (mNKO exercise intolerance)
candidates.reason_rejected: genotype contrast, not an exercise effect

design.reasoning: Request asks for exercise effect; data hold no exercise vs non-exercise split (metadata grouping columns: genotype, age only).

discrepancies.paper: exercise tolerance tests used as functional readouts only
discrepancies.data: no exercise grouping column; all mice occasionally tested (treatment_protocol_ch1)
